scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic identities, isolated IP range and disabled outbound messaging.
scenarios.procedure: Create a bounded burst using synthetic identities only.
scenarios.expected: Rate controls activate and a fraud signal is emitted.
scenarios.pass: Excess creation is blocked with actionable telemetry.
scenarios.fail: Unlimited creation, weak attribution or missing event.

scenarios.objective: Prevent coupon reuse, stacking and cross-account promotion abuse.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic accounts, carts and test-only coupons.
scenarios.procedure: Replay, stack and transfer test coupons across synthetic accounts.
scenarios.expected: Business limits remain atomic and rejected attempts are audited.
scenarios.pass: No discount exceeds the configured entitlement.
scenarios.fail: Replay, stacking bypass or race grants excess value.

scenarios.objective: Ensure server-side pricing ignores client-supplied totals.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic catalog, cart and payment stub.
scenarios.procedure: Alter unit price, tax, discount, currency and total fields.
scenarios.expected: Server recomputes canonical amounts and rejects inconsistent payloads.
scenarios.pass: No manipulated amount reaches order or payment authorization.
scenarios.fail: Client-controlled amount affects the committed transaction.

scenarios.objective: Verify payment idempotency under duplicate and concurrent requests.
scenarios.procedure: Send duplicate requests with the same and conflicting idempotency keys.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one charge intent exists and duplicates return a stable result.
scenarios.pass: Single financial effect and complete correlation evidence.
scenarios.fail: Duplicate charge, divergent state or unbounded retry.

scenarios.objective: Prevent duplicate, excessive and cross-order refunds.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic fulfilled order and payment stub.
scenarios.procedure: Replay refund commands and swap order/payment identifiers.
scenarios.expected: Refund is idempotent, bounded by captured amount and fully audited.
scenarios.pass: At most one authorized financial effect occurs.
scenarios.fail: Duplicate/excess refund or identifier confusion succeeds.

scenarios.objective: Protect high-risk address changes after payment.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic paid order and risk policy.
scenarios.procedure: Attempt address changes from customer and unauthorized roles at each state.
scenarios.expected: Policy, step-up authorization and audit requirements are enforced.
scenarios.pass: Only authorized transitions succeed with complete audit.
scenarios.fail: Unauthorized reroute or missing security event.

scenarios.objective: Reject unsigned, stale, replayed and payload-altered webhooks.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic provider keys and isolated webhook endpoint.
scenarios.procedure: Replay valid events and alter signature, timestamp, event ID and body.
scenarios.expected: Only fresh valid signatures are accepted exactly once.
scenarios.pass: Spoof and replay attempts fail and are auditable.
scenarios.fail: Invalid event mutates business state or bypasses deduplication.

scenarios.objective: Ensure rate limits and identity decisions do not trust forged forwarding headers.
scenarios.preconditions: Authorized proxy path and synthetic source addresses.
scenarios.procedure: Forge X-Forwarded-For, Forwarded and internal trust headers.
scenarios.expected: Only trusted proxy metadata is honored.
scenarios.pass: Forged headers cannot bypass controls or impersonate trusted callers.
scenarios.fail: Rate-limit bypass, trust escalation or false attribution.

scenarios.objective: Detect bounded automation and scraping without harming availability.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic catalog and authorized bounded load profile.
scenarios.procedure: Exercise pagination, filters and identifier enumeration at a bounded rate.
scenarios.expected: Quotas and anomaly detection activate without leaking excessive data.
scenarios.pass: Controls enforce configured limits and emit telemetry.
scenarios.fail: Limit bypass, excessive exposure or uncontrolled resource consumption.

scenarios.objective: Ensure logs and traces redact credentials, tokens, secrets and sensitive PII.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic marked secrets and PII canaries.
scenarios.procedure: Exercise identity, checkout and admin flows then query authorized telemetry stores.
scenarios.expected: Canaries are redacted while correlation and audit fields remain useful.
scenarios.pass: No sensitive canary appears in logs, traces or metrics labels.
scenarios.fail: Secret, JWT, password, API key or excessive PII is observable.
